# Hamza Shaikh (@HamzaShaikhAI)

> Independent software developer and open-source builder creating systems software (KeplerBridge D3D12-to-D3D11 for GT 740 / NVIDIA Kepler), AI agent tooling (AgentForge), and zero-dependency TypeScript engines (Notion Block Engine) for global engineering teams.

## Featured Open-Source Repositories

- [KeplerBridge](https://github.com/HamzaShaikhAI/KeplerBridge): Open-source C++20 Direct3D 12-to-Direct3D 11 (`d3d12.dll` proxy) compatibility layer enabling DirectX 12 workloads on legacy NVIDIA Kepler GPUs (GeForce GT 740, GTX 750, GTX 760, GTX 770, GTX 780, GTX TITAN / GK107, GK104, GK208, Feature Level 11_0) via Shader Model 6.0 DXIL-to-Shader Model 5.0 DXBC translation (v0.5.0-rc1, Windows x64, MIT).
- [AgentForge](https://github.com/HamzaShaikhAI/AgentForge): Local-first TypeScript 5.6 and Node.js (>=20) AI agent integration and workflow platform for Google Antigravity with MCP presets, Manager UI dashboard, fine-grained permission gates, human approval checkpoints, and credential isolation (MIT).
- [Notion Block Engine](https://github.com/HamzaShaikhAI/notion-block-engine): Zero-dependency TypeScript 5.0+ (<15 KB) engine for bidirectional conversion and dirty clipboard HTML sanitization (Google Docs, MS Word) between HTML, GFM Markdown, and Notion-style Block ASTs (MIT).
- [VYDRIX](https://github.com/HamzaShaikhAI/VYDRIX): Archived C#/.NET Windows cloud-backed virtual storage experiment using WinFsp, preserved with a public technical post-mortem.
